notes:
User is looking for quality, durable sandals with sturdy straps and is interested in checking out the latest collections from Teva and Merrell, two brands they regard positively. Other previously suggested brands include Birkenstock, Sanuk, and Keen; stores include REI, DSW, Zappos, and Amazon.

They plan to organize their closet this weekend to free space. They currently store old sneakers in a shoe rack and want to clean, polish, condition, or repair them through a cobbler. To find a good local cobbler, they will ask friends and family and check Google, Yelp, Facebook, or other reviews. For stored sneakers, useful measures include cleaning before storage, maintaining shape with shoe trees or acid-free stuffing, avoiding moisture, heat, and direct sunlight, allowing ventilation, using odor absorbers or silica gel, protecting them from dust and scratches, and checking periodically for mold or mildew.

They plan to donate old dress shoes to a local charity thrift store this Saturday. They intend to clean and polish them, remove personal items, and check that they are wearable and in good condition. They will call ahead and review the thrift store’s website or donation guidelines, since heavily worn, cracked, or damaged shoes may be rejected.

They also want to inventory and declutter their shoe collection, suspecting there are forgotten pairs in the closet that they have not worn in ages. Their plan is to keep, repair, donate, sell, or repurpose items as appropriate, based on last use, fit, condition, usefulness, and whether they can be easily replaced. They are considering organizing the closet by shoe type, grouping boots together, sneakers together, and similarly for other categories. They view this as a useful way to simplify finding footwear, reduce decision fatigue, make intentional future purchases, free space, and keep frequently worn shoes accessible. Suggested organizational refinements include dividers, separate out-of-season storage, stackable racks or shelves, space-saving organizers, and over-the-door racks.
